subject: Nova Research — short runway token grant while PO circulates
messages:
From: Liz Harper <liz@novaresearch.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Paul Kim <paul.kim@novaresearch.com>
Date: 2027-03-08T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Trial runway — procurement routing delay

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood's latency and the model-quality tradeoffs. We're stalled on the PO routing side: procurement has a couple of questions around data retention and the SOW that need sign-off from our legal team, and that process will push the PO out by at least a week.

We have an active sandbox with a handful of engineers iterating; if it lapses it'll interrupt a critical evaluation sprint. Is there any way Redwood can provide a short bridge (tokens or temporary credits) to keep the environment live for the team while the PO circulates? Even a small "runway" (72 hours+) would make a big difference.

Attached: "nova_statement_of_work_draft.pdf" and a screenshot of the procurement acknowledgement ("novaresearch-po-ack.png").

Happy to share our procurement contact if you need to loop them in: procure@novaresearch.com.

Thanks —
Liz Harper
Director of Engineering
Nova Research

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Liz Harper <liz@novaresearch.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Paul Kim <paul.kim@novaresearch.com>
Date: 2027-03-08T12:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial runway — procurement routing delay

Hi Liz —

Appreciate the context and the attachments. We definitely want to avoid losing momentum on your eval. I can provision a temporary runway, but I need a quick internal approval and a PO reference for the ticket.

Proposal: we can grant a provisional 72-hour token buffer immediately (small pool), and if procurement confirms the PO is in flight we can extend to a 7-day 10,000-token credit while the PO completes. The extension would be tied to the attached SOW and limited to evaluation activity (no production jobs).

Next steps for us: can you share a PO number or acknowledgement from procurement (procure@novaresearch.com is fine). I'll loop in Ben from Customer Success to monitor usage and Mateo from Sales Ops to log the credits against the deal.

If you want me to, I can also reach out to your procurement contact directly to expedite.

- Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-08T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Nova Research — short runway token grant while PO circulates

Ben / Mateo — forwarding Nova Research's note. They have a PO circulating (procure@novaresearch.com) but it won't clear for ~7 days per their update.

Request: approve a temporary runway while PO completes. My recommended guardrails: 7-day limit, 10,000-token cap, evaluation-only flag, and logging/audit entry tied to deal RDW-2027-0653. We'll require a PO reference and PO acknowledgement screenshot saved to the deal. If procurement confirms within 72 hours we can consider reducing the provisional hold once the PO is visible.

Reason: high strategic fit, strong technical signal from their engineering team, small unit cost impact relative to potential expansion.

Can you sign off so I can communicate to the customer?

Thanks,
Marissa

Subject: Re: Nova Research — short runway token grant while PO circulates

Hi Liz —

Good news: internal approval granted. We've applied a 7-day, 10,000-token evaluation credit to Nova Research's sandbox (deal RDW-2027-0653). The credit is active immediately and will expire on 2027-03-16 09:00 PT unless we receive a PO reference before then.

Notes and next steps:
- Credit cap: 10,000 tokens; activity is limited to evaluation workloads. Any heavy production usage will pause automatically and trigger a CS alert.
- Please upload the PO acknowledgement (or PO number) to the HubSpot deal record or reply here with the PO reference so we can finalize the administrative record. Our finance team will pick up for invoicing as soon as the PO clears.
- Ben (cc) will keep an eye on the environment and confirm nothing anomalous is running.

If you'd like me to contact procure@novaresearch.com directly, tell me the best person to reach and I can help nudge it along.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping your sprint rolling.

- Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
